summary: Preserve RegExp subclass construction and initialized RegExp internal slots.

target.notes: A subclass that calls super creates an instance with subclass prototype plus RegExp internal slots; System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex inheritance is not an equivalent model.

caveats: Custom subclass constructors and overridden properties remain observable.

tests.name: subclass instance is regexp
tests.input: class R extends RegExp{} const r=new R('a','g'); console.log(r instanceof R,r instanceof RegExp,r.flags);

tests.name: subclass retains lastIndex behavior
tests.input: class R extends RegExp{} const r=new R('a','g'); r.test('a'); console.log(r.lastIndex);
